title: Webb County Approves Up to $707,000 for More Repairs at Billy Hall Building
excerpt: Webb County commissioners approved up to $707,000 for another round of repairs at the Billy Hall Administrative Building, covering water damage from the July 5 flood.
content:
Webb County commissioners have approved another round of repairs at the Billy Hall Administrative Building, costing up to $707,000, according to KGNS.

The contract with Noble Texas Builders covers water damage from the July 5 flood at the county building.

The construction contract, worth $707,873, was on the Commissioners Court's Nov. 23 meeting agenda as the permanent repair work for the facility.

The same meeting agenda also listed ratification of more than $2.76 million in payments to SERVPRO for structural mitigation and moving contents after the July flooding, with those costs covered by insurance proceeds.

The three-story Billy Hall Administrative Building stands at 1110 Washington St. in Laredo.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 27, 2026; Webb County Commissioners Court agenda, Nov. 23, 2026.
